source.title: Ricochet pollination in Senna (Fabaceae) – petals deflect pollen jets and promote division of labour among flower structures

direct_result: Pollen is differentially routed between bee-accessible reward positions and transfer-favoring positions; deflector-petal ricochet contributes to pollen reaching the bee back and promotes division of labour.

morphology_guard.heteranthery_absence_basis: seven fertile stamens equal in size and shape; three sterile staminodes
sources: Muraleekrishnan et al. 2024 Journal of Threatened Taxa
morphology_guard.interpretation: Functional within-flower division does not invalidate the frozen negative heteranthery morphology state.
